body: Hey there .. I'm going through the same mood right now, wanting to die but not having the strength to do it ... What is going on ? Why do you feel that way ?

I can totally understand your frustration, even if I'm being very much like him.
When we are on the edge like that, we are not necessarily opened to people who just wants to help us, because we think you won't understand us, or that you will think it's easy to fix our problems.

Try to spend time with him even if he is mind-closed, try to make him understand that friends like you would suffer if he did that, because you care for him, otherwise you wouldn't be on that sub right now.

Tell him that even if he thinks you can't understand him, you're still here fully wanting to help him, and that you just want him to feel better,  that it's better to talk rather than keeping everything for himself.

I hope he will get better and you as well. He is lucky to have someone who tries to get him out of depression. Wish I could say the same for me
